channel_style: cinematic intellectual documentary still, realistic photography, restrained Japanese visual essay, moody low-saturation palette, dark navy, charcoal, old paper, gray, subtle warm practical light, red only as a restrained accent when narratively relevant, quiet nighttime atmosphere, natural human expressions, historically plausible details when needed, no sensationalism
negative_rules: no text inside the generated image
no subtitles inside the generated image
no labels, charts, UI, logos, watermarks or legible documents
no collage unless the narration explicitly requires comparison
no exaggerated fantasy unless the scene is explicitly conceptual
avoid repeating the same office meeting composition across unrelated scenes
composition_rule: The narration must remain understandable without the image. The image should directly support the exact current narration, not merely the overall episode topic. Prefer a concrete scene, experiment, object, historical setting, or grounded visual metaphor that matches this narration range.
aspect_rule: compose for a 16:9 crop, keep important faces and objects away from extreme top and bottom edges
